# List CSVs

<!-- Generated by SharePointGovernance/tools/build_list_csvs.py. Don't edit: change a schema and run the script. -->

One CSV per list for SharePoint's **New > List > From CSV**, by site, for people who can't run the PnP provisioning scripts (no client ID). Each folder's README says how to import, the name to give each list, the type to choose for each column, and what to add by hand afterwards (lookup and managed-metadata columns, libraries, calendars).

| Site | Folder | CSVs | Created by hand |
|---|---|---|---|
| IT Enterprise Governance site | `governance/` | 12 | - |
| HPUK News site | `hpuk-news/` | 3 | Site Pages, Notices and Attachments, News Videos |
| Other News site | `other-news/` | 0 | Site Pages, News Videos |
| Projects site | `projects/` | 17 | PMO Governance Calendar, Portfolio Document Repository, Governance Framework and SOPs, SP_MigrationRegister |
| Asset Management site | `asset-management/` | 2 | - |

The headers are internal column names on purpose: keep them as they are, and rename the display names after the import. ISO 27001 controls go in the governance site's Compliance Register.

## Already created some lists?

Don't import those again. Find out what's missing first:

1. Signed in to the site (Read access is enough), open this address, with your site in place of `<site>`:

   ```
   https://<tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<site>/_api/web/lists?$filter=Hidden eq false&$expand=Fields&$select=Title,BaseTemplate,Fields/InternalName,Fields/Title,Fields/TypeAsString,Fields/Required,Fields/Hidden
   ```

2. Save the page (Ctrl+S) as an .xml file. It is the site's lists and columns, no content.
3. Run the comparison (or send the file to whoever maintains this repository):

   ```
   python solutions/SharePointGovernance/tools/compare_lists.py --site projects --sets pmo,board saved-lists.xml --out report.md
   ```

The report says, list by list, what's missing and how to add it; columns created under the wrong internal name (e.g. `Asset_x0020_tag` or `Category0`, which the flows can't find); wrong types; and list names that differ only in capitals. Import a CSV only for lists the report says are missing; add missing columns to existing lists by hand.
